import fluentqt
from fluentqt.qmlbridge import QmlSession
from PySide6.QtCore import QTemporaryFile, QUrl
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
panel = QWidget(%PARENT%)
layout = QVBoxLayout(panel)
layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
layout.setSpacing(8)
input = fluentqt.LineEdit(panel)
input.setObjectName("playgroundQmlInput")
input.setText("A shared title")
layout.addWidget(input)
session = QmlSession(panel, panel)
session.activate()
control = session.createView(panel)
control.setFixedHeight(120)
control.setContextObject("widgetInput", input)
layout.addWidget(control)
progress = fluentqt.ProgressBar(panel)
progress.setRange(0, 100)
progress.setValue(40)
progress.hide()
control.setContextObject("widgetProgress", progress)
